1. (Currently amended) A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor comprises __force sensing material having a conductance that varies based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell__.

2. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising an adhesive layer positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, and wherein __the first sensor is in direct contact with at least one of the first battery cell or the enclosure__.

3. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein at least a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned adjacent at least a portion the first sensor in a plane between the first battery cell and the enclosure, and wherein __the first sensor is configured to detect compression forces between the first battery cell and the enclosure__.

4. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 3, wherein the adhesive layer extends around at least a portion of the first sensor in the plane.

5. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein a portion of the first sensor extends through a gap in the adhesive layer towards an edge of the first battery cell.

6. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned between the first sensor and one of the first battery cell and the enclosure.

7. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a deformable element positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, and wherein __the deformable element is configured to transmit forces to the first sensor__.

8. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein: the enclosure comprises an enclosure portion of protective film; the first sensor is positioned between first battery cell and the enclosure portion; and __the first sensor is configured to detect swelling or deformation of the first battery cell__.

9. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 8, wherein the protective film is a polyester film.

10. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein: the enclosure comprises a plastic case portion; the first sensor is positioned between first battery cell and the plastic case portion; and __the first sensor is configured to detect swelling or deformation of the first battery cell__.

11. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, and wherein __the first sensor is configured to detect compression forces between the first battery cell and the second battery cell__.

12. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 11 further comprising an adhesive layer between the first battery cell and the second battery cell.

13. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein at least a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned adjacent at least a portion the first sensor in a plane between the first battery cell and the second battery cell.

14. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 13, wherein the adhesive layer extends around at least a portion of the first sensor in the plane.

15. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein a portion of the first sensor extends through a gap in the adhesive layer towards an edge of the first battery cell.

16. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned between the first sensor and one of the first battery cell and the second battery cell.

17. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell; a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell; and __a processor in electrical communication with the first sensor and the second sensor__.

18. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 17, wherein the processor is configured to: receive a first sensor output signal from the first sensor; receive a second sensor output signal from the second sensor; conduct an evaluation based at least on the received output signals; and generate at least one processor output signal based on the evaluation, wherein __the evaluation includes comparing force measurements from the first sensor and the second sensor to determine differential stress conditions between the first battery cell and the third battery cell__.

19. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 18, wherein the processor is further configured to alter an operation of the third battery cell independently from an operation of the first battery cell based on the at least one processor output signal, wherein __the alteration is responsive to the differential stress conditions__.

20. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 18, wherein the processor is further configured to turn off the third battery cell and to maintain operation of the first battery cell based on the at least one processor output signal, wherein __the turn-off is triggered when the force measurement from the second sensor exceeds a predetermined threshold__.

21. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell; and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material, and wherein __the force sensing material comprises at least one variable electrical conductor that exhibits a first level of electrical conductance when quiescent and a second level of conductance when mechanical stress is applied__.

28. (Original) A method for monitoring a battery comprising a first cell and a second cell stacked within an enclosure, the method comprising: positioning a first sensor material between the first cell and one of the second cell and the enclosure; varying the conductance of the first material based on at least one force influencing the first cell; and producing a first force output signal based on the conductance of the first material.

29. (Original) The method of claim 28 further comprising controlling a facility of the first cell based on the force output signal.

30. (Original) The method of claim 28 further comprising: receiving a battery status signal, wherein the battery status signal is responsive to at least one of a voltage, a current, and a temperature of the first cell; evaluating the first force output signal and the battery status signal; and generating at least one evaluated output signal based on the evaluation of the first force output signal and the battery status signal.
